label: pilot-informed
reason_for_version_bump: R11: the A1 pilot preview surfaced a legitimate METHODS lesson (plain 8-charge Hamming clustering washes out single-charge decouplings -- permanent/determinant clustered together despite the counting/parallel split). That is a pilot-informed correction to the instrument, so it lands here in prereg_v3 BEFORE any structure.py run on A2 data, explicitly labeled pilot-informed. The preview may teach us about the instrument; it must not quietly tune the analysis post-hoc. Same rule for any future method adjustment. v1/v2 retained as the record.
note: Coding, predicted signatures, missingness/measured policies, method, and kill thresholds are locked BEFORE any structure.py run on A2 data (R7/R11). A changed prediction OR method is a new prereg version, never an edit.

pilot_informed_method_changes_R11.subspace_clustering: In addition to full 8-charge clustering, cluster within each locked charge-triple (below) so single-charge decouplings surface in the subspace that carries them. H2 multiplet verdicts use the subspace clustering; the full-vector clustering is reported alongside. Implemented as structure.cluster_subspaces.
pilot_informed_method_changes_R11.approx_parameterized_residual_R12: The approximation|parameterized association (Cramer's V ~0.75 in the pilot) is NOT reported as surprising until the known bridges are accounted for: EPTAS => FPT (Cesati-Trevisan 1997) and W[1]-hardness rules out EPTAS (Marx 2008). Only the RESIDUAL association after these theorem-forced bridges is H2-grade signal. Residual computation is an A3 deliverable.
pilot_informed_method_changes_R11.distance_metric: Hamming over categorical charge values remains the base metric; A3 may add a charge-weighted metric, pre-committed here as an allowed refinement (must be declared before the run that uses it).

coding_scheme.principle: Association (Cramer's V) and effective-dimensionality (MCA) treat every charge as CATEGORICAL. No charge is forced onto a numeric axis (I4).
coding_scheme.sentinels: open / unmeasured / n.a. are first-class categories in the full-table analysis and are NEVER imputed (R2). n.a. is used ONLY when the charge's object cannot be constructed (no optimization version, no unsat family); if a random ensemble could be defined the cell is open even if unstudied (R15). n.a. (structural) and open (unknown) are distinct categories.
coding_scheme.measured: measured / measured-scaling cells are coded identically to their value in the main analysis and removed in the --drop-measured ablation (R9).
coding_scheme.average_case_split_R17: SCHEMA CLARIFICATION (not a prediction change): average_case VALUE is an algorithmic-difficulty statement only (easy-on-average / hard-on-average-crypto / hard-on-average-conjectured / worst-case-to-average-equiv); the ensemble-structure fact 'a phase transition is known' is a separate boolean sub-field transition_known. Mixing the two statement types in one single-select vocab manufactured spurious associations (problems coded by whichever fact their literature emphasized -- sociology). In A3, transition_known enters as its own binary feature, analyzed separately from the difficulty value.

H1_dimensionality.prediction: Hardness is a vector: at least 3 effective dimensions; the charges do not collapse onto the decision axis.
H1_dimensionality.decision_rule: H1 SUPPORTED iff, in BOTH the full-table and the complete-case MCA (R4), at least 3 dimensions each exceed the mean eigenvalue (Kaiser-style threshold 1/Q). Requires agreement across both analyses.

H2_multiplets.prediction: Recurring charge signatures for structural reasons; verdicts use subspace clustering (R11). Locked witnesses: permanent/determinant (counting+parallel decouple at fixed decision), VC/CLIQUE (approx+param decouple at fixed decision NPC), 2-SAT/Horn/XOR-SAT (counting+parallel decouple at fixed decision P), XOR-SAT (maximal R1 decoupling), PHP (proof-size), number-partitioning (REM-like landscape).

H3_forbidden_regions.prediction: Column-forbidding entailment rules (survive the R1 object-mismatch scrutiny): E1 (counting=FP => decision in P) and E2 (parallelization defined only within P, antecedent {NPC,harder}). Object-dependent rules (E5 FPTAS, E6 inapprox, E7 approx-hardness, and the R12 EPTAS/Marx bridges) are informational, never forbidding.

missingness_policy.rule: R4 -- dual full-table (sentinels as categories) and complete-case analyses; a structure claim counts only if it holds in both.

measured_policy.rule: R9 -- structure.py runs with and without measured cells (--drop-measured); no H1/H2/H3 claim may rest on measured cells alone.

occupancy_policy.rule: R3 -- occupancy/forbidden/gap over all 2-D pairs and the pre-specified 3-D triples below (locked to prevent post-hoc triple-fishing).
occupancy_policy.gap_definition: An empty cell in an examined marginal that is NOT theorem-forbidden and has no known inhabitant, stated as a falsifiable claim.

claim_standard.surprising_vs_entailed: H1/H2 associations are reported split into entailment-forced (a known theorem/bridge links the charges -- E1/E2 and the R12 EPTAS/Marx bridges) vs residual/surprising. Only the residual is H2-grade.

kill_thresholds.population_failure_A1: MET at A1 (86.4% cited); not re-armed for A2 unless coverage regresses below 70% at the A2 standard.
kill_thresholds.degeneracy_A3: effective dimensionality ~= 1: first MCA dimension holds >= 90% of retained inertia AND median off-diagonal Cramer's V >= 0.8, in BOTH full-table and complete-case -> hardness scalar -> negative note (spec 5.2).
kill_thresholds.time_box: total attention ceiling 25 h paired; $0 compute.
